title: Global Reaction Grows After US-Russia Diesel Deal
subtitle: President Trump faces international criticism following a new agreement to import Russian fuel

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has announced a deal to import Russian diesel to lower fuel prices for American drivers. The decision has caused significant anger from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who says the money will help Russia continue its war. European leaders have also criticized the move, promising to continue their own sanctions against Moscow. Meanwhile, Trump has suggested that Ukraine needs a new leader to reach a peace deal. The situation remains tense as both sides continue to exchange strong words.
summary.zh: 美國總統川普宣布了一項進口俄羅斯柴油的協議，旨在降低美國駕駛人的燃料價格。此決定引發烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基的強烈憤怒，他表示這些資金將有助於俄羅斯繼續戰爭。歐洲領導人也批評此舉，並承諾將繼續對莫斯科實施各自的制裁。與此同時，川普暗示烏克蘭需要一位新領導人來達成和平協議。隨著雙方持續互不相讓，局勢依然緊張。

paragraphs.en: US President Donald Trump has sparked a wave of international criticism after announcing a deal to allow Russian diesel into the United States. The agreement, which suspends sanctions — official penalties used to pressure a country to change its behavior — on Russian fuel exports until April 7, is intended to lower rising fuel costs for American drivers ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. However, the move has created a deep divide between the US and its allies.
paragraphs.zh: 美國總統川普（Donald Trump）在宣布一項允許俄羅斯柴油進入美國的協議後，引發了一波國際批評。該協議暫停了對俄羅斯燃料出口的制裁——即用來施壓一國改變其行為的官方懲罰措施——直到四月七日為止，其目的是為了在即將到來的中期選舉前，降低美國駕駛人日益高漲的燃料成本。然而，此舉已在美國及其盟友之間造成了嚴重的分歧。

paragraphs.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy strongly condemned the agreement, calling it a "gift" to Russian President Vladimir Putin. According to BBC News and The Guardian, Zelenskyy argued that the money Russia earns from these sales will allow Moscow to fund its military and continue its war in Ukraine. Shortly after the deal was announced, Ukrainian officials reported a series of deadly strikes in the south-east of the country. Zelenskyy stated that Russia used the easing of pressure as a signal that it could continue its attacks on cities.
paragraphs.zh: 烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）強烈譴責這項協議，稱其為送給俄羅斯總統普丁（Vladimir Putin）的「禮物」。根據英國廣播公司新聞（BBC News）與衛報（The Guardian）報導，澤倫斯基認為，俄羅斯從這些銷售中賺取的資金，將使莫斯科當局有能力資助其軍隊並延續在烏克蘭的戰爭。在協議宣布後不久，烏克蘭官員通報該國東南部發生了一系列致命攻擊。澤倫斯基表示，俄羅斯將這種壓力的減輕視為可以繼續攻擊城市的一種訊號。

paragraphs.en: In response to the criticism, President Trump suggested that Ukraine should find a new leader. Speaking to reporters outside the White House, Trump claimed that Zelenskyy is creating problems for the world by refusing to make a deal with Russia. Trump also blamed the Ukrainian president for the high cost of fuel in the US, arguing that he has failed to stop attacks on Russian energy refineries. According to The Guardian, the Kremlin described the phone call between Trump and Putin that led to the deal as "very substantive and friendly."
paragraphs.zh: 針對這些批評，川普總統暗示烏克蘭應該尋找一位新的領導人。川普在白宮外對記者表示，澤倫斯基拒絕與俄羅斯達成協議，正在為世界製造問題。川普還將美國高昂的燃料成本歸咎於烏克蘭總統，聲稱他未能阻止對俄羅斯能源煉油廠的攻擊。據衛報報導，克里姆林宮形容促成這項協議的川普與普丁之間的通話「非常實質且友好」。

paragraphs.en: European leaders have distanced themselves from the US decision. Kaja Kallas, the European Union’s foreign affairs chief, stated that the EU would not follow the American lead. She noted that the deal provides Moscow with more money to wage war and insisted that now is not the time to ease pressure on Russia. According to Deutsche Welle, the German government also confirmed that it remains committed to its own sanctions against Russia. Germany has not imported any oil or oil products from Russia since 2023 and plans to work with European partners on further measures.
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲領導人已與美國的決定保持距離。歐盟外交事務首長卡拉斯（Kaja Kallas）表示，歐盟不會跟隨美國的腳步。她指出，該協議為莫斯科提供了更多發動戰爭的資金，並堅持現在不是放鬆對俄羅斯施壓的時候。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導，德國政府也證實，該國仍致力於執行其對俄羅斯的制裁。自二零二三年以來，德國未曾從俄羅斯進口任何石油或石油產品，並計畫與歐洲夥伴合作採取進一步措施。

paragraphs.en: In the United Kingdom, Prime Minister Andy Burnham spoke with President Zelenskyy to offer his support. A spokesperson for Downing Street reported that the two leaders discussed the importance of maintaining pressure on Russia and agreed to meet in person soon. They called for an "energy ceasefire" — an agreement to stop targeting energy infrastructure — to help stabilize global food and fuel supplies. The war, which has been worsened by conflicts in the Middle East, has caused significant problems for global energy markets, leading to high prices for families around the world.
paragraphs.zh: 在英國，首相伯恩漢（Andy Burnham）與澤倫斯基通話以表達支持。唐寧街發言人指出，兩位領導人討論了持續對俄羅斯施壓的重要性，並同意儘快親自會面。他們呼籲達成一項「能源停火」協議——即停止針對能源基礎設施的攻擊——以協助穩定全球糧食與燃料供應。這場因中東衝突而惡化的戰爭，已對全球能源市場造成重大問題，導致世界各地的家庭面臨高物價。

paragraphs.en: This deal marks a major change in the Western approach to Russia, which has focused on financial pressure since the full-scale invasion began in 2022. By choosing to suspend sanctions, the US government is attempting to address the political consequences of high inflation at home. However, the move has left many of Kyiv’s allies in Europe and NATO scrambling to adjust their own plans. As European foreign ministers prepare to approve a new, large set of sanctions on Monday, it is clear that the international community remains divided on the best way to handle the ongoing conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 這項協議標誌著西方對俄方針的重大轉變，自二零二二年全面入侵開始以來，西方國家一直聚焦於金融施壓。透過選擇暫停制裁，美國政府正試圖解決國內高通貨膨脹帶來的政治後果。然而，此舉已讓基輔在歐洲與北大西洋公約組織（NATO）的許多盟友忙於調整各自的計畫。隨著歐洲各國外交部長準備在週一批准新一輪大規模制裁，顯然國際社會對於處理當前衝突的最佳方式仍存在分歧。

paragraphs.en: For now, the situation on the ground remains dangerous. With both Russia and Ukraine intensifying their strikes on energy facilities and transport hubs, the global market for oil and diesel remains very unstable. While the US hopes that the influx of Russian fuel will provide relief to American consumers, the diplomatic cost of the deal appears to be high. As the war continues, the tension between the US administration and its European partners, as well as the relationship between Washington and Kyiv, will likely remain a central focus of global politics in the coming weeks.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，地面局勢依然危險。隨著俄羅斯與烏克蘭加強對能源設施與交通樞紐的攻擊，全球石油與柴油市場仍極度不穩定。雖然美國希望俄羅斯燃料的湧入能為美國消費者提供緩解，但該協議的外交代價似乎很高。隨著戰爭持續，美國政府與其歐洲夥伴之間的緊張關係，以及華盛頓與基輔之間的互動，在未來幾週內很可能仍將是全球政治的核心焦點。

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the specific timeframe for the suspension of sanctions on Russian fuel exports?

options.A: Until the end of the current calendar year.
options.C: Until the next full-scale invasion anniversary.
options.D: Until the midterm elections are officially concluded.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段第二句，協議明確指出暫停制裁的期限是「until April 7」。選項 A、C 皆為錯誤時間點，文章未提及；選項 D 雖然提到目的是為了選舉，但並未將選舉結束日作為制裁恢復的具體日期，屬於干擾選項。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the reaction of European nations to the US decision to import Russian diesel?

options.A: They are planning to increase their own imports of Russian fuel to match the US.
options.B: They are confused by the US decision but remain neutral on the matter.
options.C: They disagree with the US approach and are strengthening their own independent sanctions.
options.D: They have decided to follow the US lead to ensure their own energy security.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段與第六段，歐洲領導人（如 Kaja Kallas）明確表示不會跟隨美國，且德國確認維持制裁，甚至準備批准新一輪制裁。這顯示歐洲不僅不同意美國的作法，反而採取了更堅定的制裁立場，而非中立或跟隨。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'influx' mean as used in the context of the sentence: 'While the US hopes that the influx of Russian fuel will provide relief to American consumers'?

options.A: A sudden and large arrival of something.
options.B: A decrease in the price of a commodity.
options.D: A formal agreement to stop military action.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中 'influx' 指的是大量俄羅斯燃料進入美國市場。選項 B 雖是該政策的目的（減輕壓力），但非 influx 本身的意思；選項 C 與 D 與該詞彙的定義無關。此處用來形容燃料供應量的突然增加。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: The technical details of how Russian diesel is processed for US markets.
options.B: The personal relationship between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin.
options.C: The history of energy sanctions since the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
options.D: The diplomatic fallout and global division caused by the US decision to ease fuel sanctions on Russia.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章從頭至尾都在探討美國宣布暫停制裁後，引發了烏克蘭的強烈譴責、歐洲盟友的疏離以及國際間的政治分歧。選項 A 未在文中出現；選項 B 僅是背景資訊的一部分；選項 C 雖有提及，但非文章核心，文章主要關注的是此次「政策變動」帶來的當前影響。
